Type: standing desk converter
Use: raising a laptop or monitor to standing height on an existing desk; home office
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: black wood-look laminate top, black powder-coated steel scissor frame
Colors: matte black
Shape: rectangular top with rounded corners, X-shaped scissor lift, open rectangular steel base frame with side release levers, compact and portable, light visual weight
Feel: practical, sleek, functional
Goes with: black accents, grey or white walls, existing desks; modern or minimalist home offices

product.name: AmazonBasics 5-Level Adjustable/Portable Electronic Computer Workstation, Standing Desk Converter, Wood Surface - Black
product.description: Portable desktop converter for changing between sitting and standing positions throughout the day Adjusts to 5 different height levels with simple electronic controls Can be set on a desk, table, or countertop to create instant height for the optimal work experience Sturdy steel frame with contemporary wood-finish table top; includes floor protectors to eliminate damage to base surfaces Convenient foldable design for easy storage and transport Quick, simple assembly with no tools required
